To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the use of an optimized codon usage, (2) the use of a strong promoter, (3) the use of the correct vector and host strain combination, and (4) the use of appropriate culture conditions are important for the high-level expression of recombinant cytochrome P-450 proteins.

we have developed a new expression system, which we have named the “E. coli P450 Expression System (EPEX)” that allows for efficient and high-level expression of a variety of P450s, including membrane-bound P450s, in E. coli.
we have successfully expressed 12 different P450s, including P450s 1A2, 1A1, 2C9, 2C8, 2C19, 2C18, 2C11, 2B6, 3A4, 3A5, 4B1, and 2A6, in Escherichia Coli.

the development and application of a novel expression vector, pET-28b(+) for the expression and purification of recombinant proteins.
the expression of cytochromes P450, which are membrane-bound proteins that catalyze the hydroxylation of a wide variety of substrates.

the development of a high-level expression system for cytochrome P-450s in Escherichia colia and the application of this system in the preparation of a number of cytochrome-P-450s for use in the study of their catalytic and structural properties.

the most successful expression of cytochromes P450 in Escherichia colisystems has been achieved by the use of the pET expression system in the BL21 strain of E.coli, with the addition of a 6xHis tag at the N-terminus.
the best expression system for a given cytochrome P-450 will depend on the particular P-450 and its specific requirements.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the expression of membrane-bound P450 proteins in E. coli expression systems is highly dependent upon the protein of interest and the expression system employed.
a variety of modifications can be made to the P450 gene and the expression system to increase the yield of active protein.

the use of the pET-21a vector with the N-terminus modified by the addition of a 6xHis-tag and the expression of the protein under the control of a strong T7 promoter is a good start for the expression of cytochromes P450 in E. coli.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is no single optimal expression condition for all membrane proteins.
the expression of cytochromes P450 is a complex and multifaceted process that requires a multi-faceted optimization approach.
the expression of membrane P450s in E. coli is a complex process that requires a combination of various strategies to achieve the highest possible expression levels.
